infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bola needs the microphone to translate spoken Nepali and English.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bola reads text from a photo you take for translation. The photo stays on this device. It is not added to your photo library and it is not uploaded.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Bola uses speech recognition to translate what you say.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bola uses the camera to read Nepali and English text on this device. Photos are temporary translation input and are not uploaded.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Bola to access your microphone for speech translation.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Bola to recognize your speech for translation.
